title: C2: content pointer = DID, not IPNS (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: CORUNDUM drops IPNS. A user's DID document carries a service entry pointing at their latest RootManifest CID; updates are DID log entries (did:webvh, with witnesses where required); did:key users publish the pointer in their Pkarr record. One identity and one pointer for both systems.
